name: Cezz
tagline: Streamer, tinkerer, Secret-Santa wrangler, short-video channel runner and builder of slightly-too-many bots.
about: I make things for the communities I'm part of: Random Acts of Santa every Christmas, a family of interactive Instagram and YouTube Shorts channels, Twitch tools, Discord bots and Blood on the Clocktower helpers.
Most of it starts as "wouldn't it be fun if..." and ends up as a repo below.

highlights.title: Random Acts of Santa
highlights.label: raosanta.uk
highlights.description: Anonymous Christmas gifting for workplaces, Discord servers and friend groups. Share an Amazon wishlist, pick up someone else's, and spread some festive chaos. No draw, no fixed match, and no home addresses shared. Runs every year from 15 November to 6 January.

highlights.title: Interactive Shorts channels
highlights.label: quiz.cezz.co.uk
highlights.description: A family of Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts channels where the comments run the show: daily quizzes, a vote-driven dungeon crawl, play-money race betting and a colony sim on the way. Every video is rendered in code and posted automatically by my techshorts bot.

highlights.title: Potato_Cezzbb on Twitch
highlights.label: twitch.tv/Potato_Cezzbb
highlights.description: Live games and good company in chat, plus homemade stream tools like an AI co-pilot chatbot and custom overlays. Come and say hi.

socials.description: Daily quizzes on films, cartoons, food, video games and more. Answer in the comments, earn shout-outs and pick the next theme.
A serialised choose-your-adventure. Comment votes decide what happens next, and commenters can join the story.
Sixel Speedway: car races where viewers bet play money in the comments, with balances and a league table.
A new colony series, with the first episode on its way.
